replication.target_description: Study 5: 5 × 5 × 2 repeated-measures ANOVA; percentage-filled main effect, Greenhouse-Geisser corrected.

notes:
Supplied p. 22 differs from final publication p. 9. Study-level failure verdict applies to variety hypothesis; authors do not give a separate replication-success verdict for this subsidiary ANOVA term. Analytic n left null rather than substituting overall 45 complete cases.
Source follow-up: Published article; supplied title and DOI match. Source text encodes equals as p and less-than as ! in statistical expressions. Requested printed F test retained without effect-size conversion. The p. 4 locator identifies the omnibus percentage-filled main effect; a separate linear-trend test is reported on PDF p. 5 and is not substituted. Replication and reported_success are unassigned.
